### In-home care for Closter, NJ and the surrounding areas.

Comfort Keepers is a leading provider of in-home care. We strive to provide a reassuring presence for families. From companionship to personal care, we offer services and custom plans to help seniors live safe, happy, and independent lives. Our clients use our services for 24/7 live-in care, or for as little as a few hours a week. We also provide monitoring systems that help seniors live safely in their homes, and provide families with peace of mind. [Contact us](https://closter-774.comfortkeepers.com/home/quick-links/contact-us) to discuss which of our solutions could benefit you and your family. We'd be happy to set up a free in-home consultation and to create a tailored plan that serves your needs.
